_comment: Snapshot of the EV-4 EXTERNAL benchmark result. The dataset is NOT shipped (see fetch_assistments.py + data/.gitignore); this captures the measured numbers + provenance so the result lives in-repo. Reproduce with the commands below.

dataset.name: ASSISTments 2009 skill-builder (preprocessed)
dataset.reference: Choffin et al., Best Practices for Knowledge Tracing

verdict.summary: On the real ASSISTments 2009 benchmark the production Beta learner model (ADR 004) beats BOTH the BKT baseline and the RunningMean floor on Brier, AUC AND accuracy, in both the global- and causal-difficulty configurations. This REVERSES the synthetic finding (where BKT edged Beta), and defends the 'simple + explainable' model choice with an external number.
caveats: AUC ~0.698 is in the expected range for simple models on ASSISTments 2009 (DKT/SAKT reach ~0.75-0.80 with far more parameters); the claim is competitiveness + explainability, not SOTA.

No train/test split: this is an online next-step prediction protocol (predict-before-update), which is leakage-free by construction; the --running-difficulty variant additionally removes the global-difficulty train-on-all estimate.
Single dataset; EdNet/ASSISTments-2012 would strengthen generality (loader.py accepts any canonical CSV).
